# Cloudflare Developer Documentation

Explore guides and tutorials to start building on Cloudflare's platform.

> Each product below links to its own llms.txt, which contains a full index of that product's documentation pages and is the recommended way to explore a specific product's content.

## Application performance

- [Argo Smart Routing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/argo-smart-routing/llms.txt): Route web traffic across the fastest, most reliable network paths
- [Automatic Platform Optimization](https://developers.cloudflare.com/automatic-platform-optimization/llms.txt): Improve WordPress site performance by serving it from Cloudflare's global network
- [Cache / CDN](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cache/llms.txt): Make websites faster by caching content across our global server network
- [China Network](https://developers.cloudflare.com/china-network/llms.txt): Fast, global network serving visitors inside and outside of China
- [DNS](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/llms.txt): Deliver excellent performance and reliability to your domain
- [Google tag gateway for advertisers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/google-tag-gateway/llms.txt): Add a layer of data security and privacy controls when using Google Tag Manager
- [Health Checks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/health-checks/llms.txt): Monitor IPs or hostnames and get notified of issues
- [Load Balancing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/load-balancing/llms.txt): Maximize application performance and availability
- [Smart Shield](https://developers.cloudflare.com/smart-shield/llms.txt): Safeguard your origin with just a few clicks.
- [Spectrum](https://developers.cloudflare.com/spectrum/llms.txt): Secure and accelerate any TCP or UDP-based application
- [Speed](https://developers.cloudflare.com/speed/llms.txt): Improve the performance of your website or web application
- [SSL/TLS](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ssl/llms.txt): Encrypt your web traffic to prevent data theft and other tampering
- [Waiting Room](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waiting-room/llms.txt): Create a virtual waiting room to manage peak traffic
- [Cloudflare Web Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/llms.txt): Get vital web analytics for your website
- [Web3](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web3/llms.txt): Gateways to networks to help you develop applications without worrying about running infrastructure

## Application security

- [API Shield](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api-shield/llms.txt): Identify and address your API vulnerabilities
- [Bots](https://developers.cloudflare.com/bots/llms.txt): Protect your domain from bad bot traffic
- [Client-side security](https://developers.cloudflare.com/client-side-security/llms.txt): Provide client-side protection for your website visitors
- [Challenges](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-challenges/llms.txt): Verify visitors are not bots with lightweight challenges
- [DDoS Protection](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ddos-protection/llms.txt): Protect against DDoS attacks automatically with uncompromised performance
- [DMARC Management](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dmarc-management/llms.txt): Protect your email domain and stop brand impersonation
- [Firewall Rules (deprecated)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/firewall/llms.txt): Create rules that examine incoming HTTP traffic against a set of powerful filters to block, challenge, log, or allow matching requests. Firewall Rules have been replaced with WAF custom rules.
- [Key Transparency Auditor](https://developers.cloudflare.com/key-transparency/llms.txt): Secure the distribution of public keys in E2EE messaging systems
- [Secrets Store](https://developers.cloudflare.com/secrets-store/llms.txt): Encrypt and store sensitive information as secrets that are securely reusable across an account
- [Security Center](https://developers.cloudflare.com/security-center/llms.txt): Enhance your security posture with a range of security products and one-click solutions
- [Turnstile](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/llms.txt): Turnstile is Cloudflare's smart CAPTCHA alternative
- [WAF](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/llms.txt): Filter incoming traffic and protect against web app vulnerabilities

## Cloudflare One

- [Cloudflare Network Firewall](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-network-firewall/llms.txt): Protect your enterprise network with advanced firewall-as-a-service protection
- [Cloudflare One](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/llms.txt): Replace legacy security perimeters with Cloudflare's network to protect your organization
- [Cloudflare WAN](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-wan/llms.txt): Replace legacy WAN and securely connect any traffic source to Cloudflare's network
- [Data Localization Suite](https://developers.cloudflare.com/data-localization/llms.txt): Control where Cloudflare stores and inspects data
- [Multi-Cloud Networking](https://developers.cloudflare.com/multi-cloud-networking/llms.txt): Automate resource discovery and simplify managing your public cloud infrastructure

## Consumer services

- [1.1.1.1 (DNS Resolver)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/llms.txt): A blazing fast DNS resolver built for private browsing
- [Radar](https://developers.cloudflare.com/radar/llms.txt): Investigate Internet usage around the world using Cloudflare's data
- [WARP Client](https://developers.cloudflare.com/warp-client/llms.txt): Allows individuals or organizations to have a faster, more secure connection to the Internet

## Core platform

- [AI Crawl Control](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-crawl-control/llms.txt): Analyze and control third-party AI crawlers in your website
- [Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/llms.txt): Visualize the performance, security, and reliability data collected by Cloudflare products
- [Billing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/billing/llms.txt): Manage billing, plans, and subscriptions for your account
- [Cloudflare Fundamentals](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/llms.txt): Learn about using Cloudflare and features that span across Cloudflare products
- [Log Explorer](https://developers.cloudflare.com/log-explorer/llms.txt): Store and explore your logs in the Cloudflare dashboard or API
- [Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/llms.txt): Access detailed logs with metadata from Cloudflare products
- [Network](https://developers.cloudflare.com/network/llms.txt): Manage Cloudflare network settings for your website
- [Notifications](https://developers.cloudflare.com/notifications/llms.txt): Define what you want to be notified about and how
- [Pulumi](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pulumi/llms.txt): Create, deploy, and manage Cloudflare resources in various programming languages
- [Randomness Beacon](https://developers.cloudflare.com/randomness-beacon/llms.txt): Explore drand, a distributed service providing randomness to applications
- [Reference Architecture](https://developers.cloudflare.com/reference-architecture/llms.txt): Guides and diagrams explain Cloudflare products and how to integrate with IT architectures
- [Registrar](https://developers.cloudflare.com/registrar/llms.txt): Buy and renew your domain at cost, add another layer of security to your DNS records for free
- [Resource Tagging](https://developers.cloudflare.com/resource-tagging/llms.txt): Attach key-value metadata to Cloudflare resources for organization, access control, and billing attribution
- [Rules](https://developers.cloudflare.com/rules/llms.txt): Modify incoming requests, change Cloudflare settings, or trigger actions
- [Ruleset Engine](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ruleset-engine/llms.txt): Create rulesets and rules for different Cloudflare products
- [Support](https://developers.cloudflare.com/support/llms.txt): Cloudflare Support-focused documentation
- [Tenant](https://developers.cloudflare.com/tenant/llms.txt): Provision and manage Cloudflare accounts and services for your team or customers
- [Terraform](https://developers.cloudflare.com/terraform/llms.txt): Define and store Cloudflare configurations in source code repositories like GitHub
- [Time Services](https://developers.cloudflare.com/time-services/llms.txt): Cloudflare's suite of time services: NTP, NTS, and Roughtime
